svg.text: How our model works: classical machine learning
Asteroid Hunter · for every blob: measure 49 numbers, then 600 decision trees (XGBoost) vote on whether it is a real moving object
each one a question a person would ask
unsupervised: the 20 directions in which stamps differ most
gradient boosting: each tree fixes the errors of the ones before
looks like a star < 0.457 ? it is 0.808 → no
old picture at centre < 9.43 ? it is 0.251 → yes
dark pixels nearby < 0.215 ? it is 0 → yes
WHERE THIS MODEL SITS IN THE WHOLE PIPELINE
600 trees, depth 4 · trained on 53,178 stamps in seconds · AP 0.902 (validation), 0.938 (test) · old baseline 0.783 · CNN (deep learning, comparison only) 0.898
